notes.title: Minor Patch v1.2.72
notes.content:
Hey all!

How have you been doing? It's been a while! Hope you've done your taxes by now, unless you got an extension, because if you haven't... um... uh oh.

All that aside, I'm here to announce that Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game V1.2.72 has landed!

Overall with this patch we wanted to clear out some minor issues while we work out the details of the next big patch, this means bug fixes and feedback incorporation! Thanks to all of you who have added your thoughts on how Cricket can be even better!

Now, what's in this patch:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

- Boss difficulty tweaking: Now you can make the bosses easier / harder, separate from normal enemies! This will give you a bit more control over the whole experience!
- New 2540x1440 screen resolution: 2k and 4k support are coming soon, but we wanted to test one resolution up to see how it feels.

[h1]Content Changes[/h1]

- Dialogue lines have been edited / extended to explain the world in more depth and detail!
- Some characters have new face art!

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

- In VERY Hard Mode, status effects no longer function as an instant defeat.

[h1]Misc.[/h1]

- The final boss fight no longer has coloration issues if you turned on Attack Color Assist.
- Hard Mode has been renamed to VERY Hard Mode. Seriously, it's tough!

As for what comes next: Version v1.3 will have content updates! More stuff to do and more fun to be had!

Thank you so much for playing and (ideally) enjoying Cricket, we do believe this is the best version of the game yet!

notes.title: Version 1.2: The "Big Heccin'" Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hey all!

How have you been doing? It's been a while! Have you gotten around to doing your taxes? I've been trying to handle them but I have this thing I gotta do, and this other thing, you know?

All that aside, I'm here to announce that Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game V1.2: The "Big Heccin'" Update, is finally here!

Overall with this patch we aimed to bring Cricket closer in line with our initial vision of the game, things we wanted to fix and address for a while but straight up didn't have time to do. This means re-balancing the game, focusing up on some of the game's systems, bringing in some more story elements, and giving players a reason to explore the game world a bit more.

In particular, we wanted players to be able to tune their adventure with Jae and friends to their liking, as we heard a variety of opinions on the difficulty of the initial version of the game. The feedback did NOT go unheard!

Now, what's in this patch, you are almost certainly asking. Be patient! Just kidding, here's the patch notes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

- Optional hard mode: get the button timing for moves right or suffer huge consequences.
- Options menu has an enemy scale slider to make the game easier / harder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/73db82fd84b07da55fa0d30e5ac1668c3ef304a3.png[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]

- New weapons have been added: 3 for each character.
- New armor has been added: 3 for each character.
- New enemies: more robots, sock puppets, and sharks.
- Some enemies have new attacks.
- Enemies are tuned to be more difficult by default.
- Fewer enemy encounters, and time between respawns has been increased.
- More interactables, as in, more things to bump into!
- Some side characters now appear in town after their story sections are complete.
- Cutscene before final fight has additional dialogue and some fun other stuff ;)
- As you clear the game, check the Voicemail section of the Blokia menu every once in a while, you'll see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/8d09740a6671b13dc534da35386f97179e2aafbd.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

- Treasure has been moved around and is more interesting, more character tokens have been placed around the map.
- Character tokens boost stats, find as many as you can!
- More abilities have status effects, and status effects are more incorporated into the game strategy overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/da7a2e7758bf2a62df26d8ce396c0c647a02e47f.png[/img]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]

- Player attack descriptions are more helpful.
- Friendship levels are capped at 10 to reduce confusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/6c440bf63d58a20187c812c02d73c094ac23ec96.png[/img]

For more information on the decision making behind this update, you can read more on our website [url=https://www.studiokumiho.com/post/behind-the-scenes-of-v1-2-the-big-heccin-update]here[/url]!

Thank you so much for playing and (ideally) enjoying Cricket, we do believe this is the best version of the game yet!

notes.title: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is 2 WEEKS OLD!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Wow, two weeks (and change) have already passed, and it's been a pretty wild ride! I wanna take a moment to thank everyone who has picked up a copy of Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game thus far, and a double thanks to all of you who have left a review! Once again, your feedback is welcome and has identified many things for us to fix up. We're really happy about the positive reception to the game, with us finally getting a "Positive" rating here on Steam!

I'm really happy to be have seen messages from folks who have enjoyed the gameplay and story so far, it really warms my heart after a great many years of work. Not saying you have to send more, but I have appreciated all the messages!

With that, let's talk about...

[h2]FEATURES ROADMAP[/h2]

I want to be transparent with you all about what's being worked on currently. This game is coded up by one person (me) so I appreciate your patience as I handle each of these things one by one:

[list]
[*] Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One ports
[*] Playstation 5 crash bug deep dive (it's a nasty one)
[*] Playstation 4 port
[*] Remappable controls (all systems)
[*] Language select menu
[*] Quicksaving
[/list]
[h2]FIXES SO FAR[/h2]

Thanks to all of your input, we've been able to implement the following changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] Added more save locations (More than double!)
[*] Options menu in the Main Menu
[*] Reduced enemy spawn frequency
[*] Fixed various NPC and cutscene display issues in later parts of the game
[*] Added "Press to Sprint" option to the Options menu. Now you don't have to hold down the sprint button if you don't want to.
[*] Added "Win Button" option to the Options menu. We heard you about it being on by default, so we moved it away.
[*] Memory optimizations
[*] Placed missing collisions
[*] Notoriety meter display cleanups in various menus
[*] Overall game stability is MUCH better
[/list]
Feel free to make suggestions as you see fit in the Steam Forums, I check it regularly.

[h2]OST Track - Autumn Evening[/h2]

Something we consistently hear is how you love the music of the game, so here's one of the tracks on YouTube, Autumn Evening! It's Twila's theme!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AWx0Mrhvotc

notes.title: Cricket JRPG Monthly Update: May 2024 Edition!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all![/h1]

Tax season is over, did you turn in all of your stuff? Got some feds on your doorstep? We can't help with that, but I have an update for you about Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game!

... That didn't help, did it?

This month, we'll go over one of the more unique mechanics of Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game: [b]The Notoriety Meter![/b]

[h2]What is the Notoriety Meter?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/ecdf55c6cca77ff6cfab7344e58f93f9ea772df6.png[/img]

As you explore the world, you can mess with the NPCs, such as bumping into them and throwing objects at them. Doing so increases your Notoriety Meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/8a3bcd6381c3e09b0a9ebb0e77b7035b29284ef1.png[/img]

But what happens when you fill the meter?
[list]
[*] Enemies do more damage and have more health in battle
[*] Winning battles grants you more money, more XP, and better items
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/cbefbad4ef5762dc85d2f981f4970b9b8cbc8ef1.gif[/img]

The meter will decrease over time, so if you want the game to ease up, it's not difficult!

Utilize the [b]The Notoriety Meter[/b] to level up faster and reduce any grinding you might be doing! Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is designed so that you shouldn't have to grind, but just in case! Maybe it'll be a speedrunning strategy?

What inspired this idea? Uh, well we had this whole "messing with NPCs" thing, and wanted to roll that into the rest of the game's systems. That's really it!

We look forward to releasing the game to you all on 8/15, and to seeing your thoughts on the [b]Notoriety Meter[/b]!

[h1]Hey all![/h1]

How have you been? How are your family and friends? How's the thing you've been working on? Have you finally looked into that other thing?

This month, we had a thought to go over one of the core, yet unique battle mechanics of Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game: [b]The Tide Meter![/b]

[h2]What is the Tide Meter?[/h2]

As you fight, and land your hit timings, you will gain [b]Tide Meter[/b], which can be used to:
[list]
[*] Boost your attacks
[*] Enable team attacks
[*] Slow down time and make blocking / parrying enemy attacks easier
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/cdd1e5a5201b323e5b4b0d25161f16b27adcd2e6.gif[/img]

Boosted attacks do more damage, make status effects last longer, and make status effects more likely to take effect!

You will wanna utilize [b]Tide Meter[/b] to make battling in Cricket far easier, it's rough going out there! It can really get you out of a bind or force the enemy into skipping turns, and the like! [u][b]Be careful though, enemies can use Tide Meter too[/b][/u]!

If you NEED to use meter now, you can overspend on your turn, but be careful, that gives the enemy [b]FREE METER[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/64373b741b8f1c5ac27adaa4e8a41e43c8910362.png[/img]

We look forward to releasing the game to you all on 8/15, and to seeing your thoughts on the [b]Tide Meter[/b]!

Let's hope this update crashes into your feed like this spell from Twila!

There's been a ton of developments since we've last talked, a lot to mention! We've been working on engine improvements (Cricket is built on Kumiho Engine 2.0), while implementing the rest of our cast list!

Since it's been a while, let's do a quick reminder of what [b]Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game[/b] is:

[b]Cricket: Jae’s Really Peculiar Game[/b] is a heartfelt JRPG with exploration focused on interactions with the world and characters through childish antics, and battles focused on combining attacks with friends and calling out the opponent's tendencies.
The hand drawn art and unique perspective will capture player’s eyes. The story of loss, loneliness, and friendship will capture player’s hearts. The battles will capture players attention by focusing on understanding enemy patterns, with pairing up with friends being critical to success.

With that description out of the way, for today we'll show our mage, our damage dealer, [b]Twila[/b]!

Hope you're doing well! Just here to announce that Symphony, the girl who crash lands a traffic cone at the end of our first demo, [b]will be playable for the first time ever at PAX West 2022![/b]

Symphony is a hard hitting and fast moving character, with devastating two hit attacks and an awesome trio attack with Zack and Jae! Be careful though: she has lower health and defense due to her reckless strategy!

Enjoy some pics of her and how she looks in game! We're excited to show her to you all. Show up to booth #756 at PAX and give her a try!

notes.title: We're Going to be at PAX West 2022!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hey all![/h2][/b]
Feeling good from last year, we decided that we're showing [b]Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game[/b] at PAX West 2022 (9/2-9/6)! Drop by booth #756 and nab some swag! The feedback from the previous year was really encouraging, and we are excited to be there again.

Exclusively at the event there will be a new free roam demo featuring a new character: Symphony! That's right, [b]SHE'S FINALLY PLAYABLE[/b]! We will also be handing out a brand new poster design for those who play the demo to the end!

Don't be afraid to say hi, we're a friendly bunch and would love your company.

For the folks at home: we will activate our demo on Steam again, it'll be largely the same as the one from Next Fest, so if you missed it the last go around, here's your second chance!

Thank you so much for your continued interest in [b]Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game[/b]! Your support is everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/ad44c9ce74cb5c108e2eec9adcdaedf315a57d29.png[/img]

notes.title: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game will be at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We're proud to announce that we'll be a part of Steam Next Fest from 6/13 - 6/20! During that time, our demo will be playable!

Yes, [u][b]you can give the game a try![/b][/u]
Yes, the game is a long way out, but we thought to let you all have a taste of what's to come!

The demo will feature the city of Marion, which you can see in the images below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/4ee54e3f47808d94cdd99c5d80db2d0aa8dbbae0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/58444f9ab2c374327295cf09b449321477c56f0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/a24ca93422fe02904ab843092ea6ea8205a00103.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38500927/951eea3ca5cac51b5342e8682b8a0fa259ac498d.png[/img]

Some may recognize that it's the same town as the demos from last year, but we swear the art style has been improved and we added a ton of new features. We heard your feedback and are back with something even better!

But yeah, give the game a try while it's available!
